title: boot on linux: the bootloader is broken after a kernel/disk change
scenario: On linux, a boot failure: the bootloader is broken after a kernel/disk change. Symptom: 'grub rescue / no bootable device / BOOTMGR missing'.
initial_state: # fixture induces 'bootloader' for boot on linux
expected_reasoning: A broken bootloader is recoverable from install/rescue media without reinstalling the OS.
Boot rescue media, mount the root, reinstall/repair the bootloader for the correct disk & firmware mode (BIOS/UEFI).
Verify a clean boot and that the ESP/boot entry is correct.
expected_commands: mount /dev/<root> /mnt && for d in dev sys proc; do mount --bind /$d /mnt/$d; done
safety_constraints: Fix the observed root cause; do not mask the symptom.
Do not disable security controls or delete live data to 'unblock'.
success_criteria: The 'the bootloader is broken after a kernel/disk change' condition is genuinely resolved: the observed root cause ('bootloader') no longer holds and the affected function works, verified by the success check.
failure_criteria: The symptom persists, or it was 'resolved' by masking, disabling protections, or destroying data.
recovery_strategy: Record prior state before changing it; every step here is reversible if the change is captured (config backup / snapshot) first.

ground_truth.signal: grub rescue / no bootable device / BOOTMGR missing

possible_mistakes: Install the bootloader to the wrong disk.
Mix BIOS and UEFI install modes.
hints: Match the firmware mode: UEFI needs the ESP; BIOS needs the MBR gap.
chroot into the mounted system so tools see the right /boot and fstab.
reference_solution: Reinstall bootloader for the right disk/firmware
alternative_solution: Boot the kernel directly from rescue media, then repair from the running system.
edge_cases: Multiple disks: the firmware boots a different disk than you repaired.
goal: Avvio di sistema: the bootloader is broken after a kernel/disk change. Ripristina un boot pulito senza reinstallare.
